title: Tech Note: Deploying 4D Server 64-bit for Mac
author: Timothy A. Penner, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note documents a one-time, long-completed platform transition: 4D Server has been 64-bit-only for many years now, and ServerNet has been the standard (not new) network layer since shortly after this note was published, so the specific migration guidance, unsupported-features caveats, and legacy-network-layer toggling described here no longer apply to any current 4D deployment.
related_updates: Current 4D Server, which is 64-bit-only with ServerNet as the sole, mature network layer
Modern 4D security/connection guidance superseding the encrypted-connection setup described here
